about: Wording that this app changed on purpose, compared with the original dashboard.
tools/golden/original-dashboard.json is still the recording of the ORIGINAL page and is never edited.
Before comparing, tools/parity.mjs and the unit tests rewrite the recorded texts with the rules below,
so every number, class, colour and list entry is still checked against the original, and only these
phrases are allowed to differ. A rule replaces every occurrence of `from` with `to` in the probe named
by `where`. Rules run in order. A rule that matches nothing in the recording fails the parity check,
so this list cannot go stale. To change a text on screen: change it in the app and add or edit a rule here.
